title: Counsel, Commercial and Strategic Initiatives
posting_excerpt:
a strong culture with plenty of opportunities for team-building and camaraderie.

Interested in joining us on our mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible? We’d love to talk.

Who You Are

As Counsel, Commercial & Strategic at Hometap, you'll serve as a legal advisor embedded across the business. You'll spend most of your time as a cross-functional partner to teams navigating legal and regulatory questions, with about 30% of your time focused on commercial and vendor agreements.

You’re a great fit for this role if you bring nuance and practical judgment to business challenges, and are comfortable partnering directly with various departments and department heads. You evaluate risk pragmatically, balancing growth with protecting the organization rather than defaulting to caution. You’re curious and quick to pick up new subject areas, translating legal requirements into clear direction for the business. In this role you’ll need to be confident making independent decisions, and self-aware enough to know when to ask questions or escalate. As a parter to our business teams, you'll have a meaningful impact on the work we do internally and for our homeowners.

What You'll Do

Business Partnership & Strategic Initiative Support (70%)

- Legal Guidance: Advise on diverse legal and regulatory matters, including data privacy, artificial intelligence deployment, dispute resolution

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Engage regularly with departmental leadership to align legal strategy with broader commercial objectives and serve as a central connector between functional teams and the legal practice

- Operational Optimization: Partner with legal operations leads to streamline team workflows, optimize automated systems, refine guidance materials, and build scalable processes

- Pragmatic Risk Assessment: Deliver actionable, solution-oriented advice on daily operational inquiries, resolving unexpected challenges with a focus on risk mitigation and growth

Commercial & Vendor Strategy (30%)

- Contract Negotiations: Draft, review, and negotiate technology agreements, vendor arrangements, professional service contracts, and strategic partnership agreements

- Third-Party Risk Management: Collaborate with finance, technology, and operations teams to structure vendor engagements and ensure compliance with regulatory standards

What You'll Bring

- J.D. degree from accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing

- 4+ years of relevant legal experience spanning firm, in-house, or hybrid environments; 1+ years in-house experience is preferred

- Experience in consumer financial services, fintech, mortgage lending, or highly regulated consumer-facing industry strongly preferred

- Proven experience structuring, drafting, and negotiating commercial agreements and technology contracts (NDAs, SOWs, DPAs, SaaS, vendor contracts, MSAs, etc.)

- Strong desire to stretch across new domain areas—such as AI, privacy, litigation, and legal operations—with ease in managing varied daily responsibilities

- A business-first approach to law, featuring the ability to evaluate risk thoughtfully and unlock business potential rather than acting as a simple veto point

- Sound judgment, self-assurance in decision-making, and comfort communicating directly with senior leadership

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of translating complex concepts into plain, accessible language

- Comfort with ambiguity, strong organizational capabilities, self-motivation, and a collaborative orientation in a fast-paced setting

The salary range for this role is $185,000 - $200,000, depending on your experience, skills, location, and other factors. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, so you can share in our growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

title: Corporate Counsel, Commercial
posting_excerpt:
work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why would you love this job?

You’ll be the fifth member of a tight global commercial and product legal team supporting Redis’ global go-to-market, where you’ll own your workstreams from day one while getting hands-on mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers. The work spans enterprise SaaS, software licensing, and international commercial agreements across Redis’ global customer base, which includes more than 75% of the Fortune 50.

This role is built for someone with curiosity and drive: curiosity to understand the business behind every deal, and drive to own outcomes, not just tasks. The pace is fast, the deals are real, and you’ll be in the room for the ones that matter.

We’re actively building an AI-augmented legal function, and you’ll have a direct hand in shaping what that looks like, from playbook design to contract workflow automation.

You’ll report directly to the Deputy General Counsel, Commercial & International, and partner with colleagues around the world.



What You’ll Do

 - Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements including SaaS subscriptions, software licenses, NDAs, DPAs, and vendor/supplier contracts.

 - Support senior counsel on complex deal structuring and negotiations.

 - Collaborate with Sales, Procurement, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and Security to align contracts with business goals and risk frameworks.

 - Support new product launches by drafting and reviewing customer-facing terms and go-to-market agreements.

 - Advise on privacy matters and support compliance with data protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA, and others).

 - Improve contract templates, playbooks, and processes, including through AI-powered tools.

 - Provide practical, business-oriented legal guidance to internal stakeholders.

 - Opportunities to collaborate in the broader book of business in the Legal Team.
   
   

What will you need to have?

 - JD from an ABA-accredited law school and active admission to a US state bar in good standing.

 - 2–4 years of experience in commercial, SaaS, or technology transactions (law firm or in-house).

 - Familiarity with data privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA) and software licensing models.

 - Curiosity to dig into the “why” behind business and legal problems, not just the “what.”

 - A bias toward ownership: you follow through, close loops, and don’t wait to be told what’s next.

 - Clear, concise communication skills and strong organizational instincts.

 - Genuine interest in adopting AI-based legal tools and working at the frontier of how legal teams operate.

Extra great if you have:

 - Prior in-house experience at a high-growth technology company.

 - Undergraduate degree in business, computer science, or a technology-related field.

 - Experience with multi-state commercial contracts or vendor negotiations.

 - Proficiency in a second language (French, German, Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese).

We give back to our employees:

Our culture is what makes Redis a fun and rewarding place to work. To support you at work and beyond, we offer all our US team members fantastic benefits and perks:

 - Competitive salaries and equity grants

 - Unlimited time off to promote a healthy work-life balance

 - H/D/V coverage along with 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits

 - Frequent team celebrations and recreation events

 - Home internet & phone stipend

 - Learning and development opportunities

 - Ability to influence a high-performance company on its way to IPO



The estimated gross base annual salary range for this role is $145,000 - $160,000 per year in New York, California, Washington, Colorado, and Rhode Island. As Suki’s Commercial Counsel, you’ll handle a variety of legal, commercial, and product counseling issues. This position isn’t a role where you’ll just redline documents and pass them off; you will be deeply embedded in our commercial growth and the success of the company.

Key Responsibilities:

- Serve as the point person for commercial deals. You’ll draft, negotiate, and advise cross-functional teams on a wide variety of commercial agreements, including new business development initiatives, software licenses, partnership agreements, and vendor contracts.

- Build, streamline, and operationalize Suki’s contracting process to help us scale, including creating new playbooks to help the Sales team automate their sales motions.

- Provide thoughtful and practical business and legal advice on various legal risks, business strategies, and other issues related to commercial transactions, data privacy, and the shifting landscape of AI regulation.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal concepts into actionable, collaborative business advice.

- Highly organized, reliable, detail-oriented, and diligent.

- Ability to work on multiple issues simultaneously and to set appropriate priorities with clients and to deliver results efficiently.

- Ability to operate autonomously, while being a team player who brings a positive attitude to the job.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience and knowledge of privacy laws, including HIPAA and GDPR, and emerging regulatory policies on Generative AI and data security.

- Venture-backed: We’ve raised $215 M from top VCs like Venrock, First Round, Flare, and March Capital.

- Massive market: We’re disrupting a $30B+ industry, and our momentum is real.
